name: Military Liaisons
source:
With the perfection of the cold fusion reactor under their wing the Royal Holloway Space Corporation has it’s eyes firmly set in the stars. Well, better said, they have their eyes firmly set on nearby asteroids. Why? Asteroid mining for precious and rare metals of course!

They’ve developed the ships that will conduct this mission, now all they need are the pilots…

“Military Liaisons” is an arcade space-shooter/Visual Novel where you play as Flight Lieutenant Colin Michaels, an ace RAF pilot that is sent to the Royal Holloway Space Corporation’s secret test facility in Switzerland for a competition to see which country’s pilots are best qualified for this strange but marvellous mission.

[From [url=http://sapphiredragonproductions.com/military-liaisons/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
皇家霍洛威航天公司已经完善了冷聚变反应堆，如今正把目光牢牢投向星辰。嗯，说得更准确些，是附近的小行星。为什么？当然是为了开采小行星上的贵重稀有金属！

他们已经研制出执行任务的飞船，现在只差飞行员……

《Military Liaisons》是一款结合街机太空射击与视觉小说的游戏。你将扮演英国皇家空军的王牌飞行员Colin Michaels上尉。他被派往皇家霍洛威航天公司位于瑞士的秘密测试设施，参加一场竞赛，选出哪个国家的飞行员最适合执行这项奇特而又非凡的任务。
